column1: # West: each host file this repository is the source for (S-WEST-GROUND, ADR-147).
# Modes: exact (byte for byte), contains (every non-comment line of the repo file is
# a whole line of the host file), redact (keys and passwords masked, comments and
# blank lines dropped, then compared), absent (the host path must not exist; repo_path -).
# Checked by scripts/check-host-settings.sh --host west (root, on a timer).
